name: refused_names_supplier
about: A tool reads a value that no one has saved yet. A task saves that value, so the refusal tells the model to run the task first.
instructions: You help callers with their orders.

tasks.when: The caller gives an order number.

model.result: {"refused": "order_id not set yet. Run find_order first: it saves order_id, then call this tool again."}
